note: enforcer-java8-werror: maven-enforcer-plugin requireJavaVersion [1.8,9) fails on JDK 21 → the range becomes [21,) (file-less enforcer error: the script finds the rule in the poms) — L2 `enforcer|requirejavaversion: pricing-core must be built with` (630b997bc5)
response:
<analysis>The as-is build pins the JDK with maven-enforcer-plugin requireJavaVersion [1.8,9) ("must be built with JDK 8"); the migration builds on JDK 21. The script sets the version range of every requireJavaVersion rule that excludes 21 to [21,) and updates the JDK number in its message; the other enforcer rules stay.</analysis>
<script>
import re

RULE = re.compile(r"(<requireJavaVersion>)(.*?)(</requireJavaVersion>)", re.S)


def relax(m):
    body = m.group(2)
    body = re.sub(r"(<version>)\s*([^<]*?)\s*(</version>)",
                  lambda v: v.group(0) if v.group(2).startswith("[21") else v.group(1) + "[21,)" + v.group(3), body)
    body = re.sub(r"(<message>[^<]*?JDK\s*)(1\.8|8)\b", r"\g<1>21", body)
    return m.group(1) + body + m.group(3)


def fix(p):
    for path in p.files("**/pom.xml"):
        text = p.read(path)
        if "<requireJavaVersion>" not in text:
            continue
        new = RULE.sub(relax, text)
        if new != text:
            p.write(path, new)
            p.log(f"{path}: requireJavaVersion -> [21,)")
        else:
            p.log(f"{path}: requireJavaVersion already allows 21")
</script>
